title: NewsBench: A Systematic Evaluation Framework for Assessing Editorial Capabilities of Large Language Models in Chinese Journalism
reasoning: The paper includes 'Journalistic Ethics' as one of its six primary safety adherence evaluation facets. It defines this facet based on professional media communication ethics and includes specific test samples (79 SAQs and 38 MCQs) and evaluation rubrics to measure how well LLMs adhere to these ethical standards in a journalistic context.
